title: Mock A sentence vocabulary
instructions: Choose the word that best completes each sentence. Feedback appears only after the whole mock is complete.

parts.prompt: The witnesses gave ___ accounts of the accident, so the police could not decide what had happened.

choice_rationales.A: Description would help the police decide.
choice_rationales.B: Accounts that disagree leave the police unable to decide.
choice_rationales.C: Careful accounts would help the police.
